# Vibe Index

> Vibe Index is a project discovery and sharing platform where developers and creators submit, browse, and discuss software projects. Think of it as a community-driven directory for the latest tools, apps, and APIs across 12 categories.

Key actions visitors can take:
- Browse and search projects by category, pricing model, or keyword
- Submit a new project for AI-powered analysis and community listing
- Subscribe to category-specific email digests (daily, weekly, or monthly)
- Like, follow, and comment on projects
- Earn listing credits by sharing projects on social media

Categories: AI & Machine Learning, Developer Tools, Web Apps, Mobile Apps, APIs & Backend, Games, E-Commerce, Productivity, Social & Community, Education, Finance, Design & Creative.

## Browse Projects

- [All Projects](/): Browse, search, and filter the full project directory
- [AI & Machine Learning](/?category=ai-ml): AI, ML, and LLM projects
- [Developer Tools](/?category=dev-tools): CLIs, editors, and developer utilities
- [Web Apps](/?category=web-apps): Full-stack web applications
- [Mobile Apps](/?category=mobile-apps): iOS and Android applications
- [APIs & Backend](/?category=apis-backend): Backend services and APIs
- [Games](/?category=games): Games and interactive experiences
- [E-Commerce](/?category=ecommerce): Online stores and marketplaces
- [Productivity](/?category=productivity): Task management and productivity tools
- [Social & Community](/?category=social): Social platforms and community tools
- [Education](/?category=education): Learning platforms and educational tools
- [Finance](/?category=finance): Fintech and financial tools
- [Design & Creative](/?category=design-creative): Design tools and creative platforms

## Submit a Project

- [Submit Project](/submit): Submit a new project URL for AI-powered analysis and community listing. The system automatically extracts metadata, generates descriptions, and suggests categories. Users get 3 free listing credits to start.

## Subscribe to Updates

- [Subscribe to Digests](/subscribe): Subscribe to category-specific email digests delivered daily, weekly, or monthly. Filter by pricing model (free, paid, or all) and customize the number of projects per digest.

## API

- [List Projects](/api/projects): GET — Browse projects with search, category, pricing, sort, and pagination parameters
- [Get Project](/api/projects/{id}): GET — Get full details for a specific project
- [Get Categories](/api/categories): GET — List all 12 project categories
- [Health Check](/api/hello): GET — Verify the API is running

## Optional

- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Manage your submitted projects, credits, and notifications (requires login)
- [Login](/login): Create an account or sign in to submit projects, like, follow, and comment
